findings.title: Schema-invalid reports can pass as complete
findings.trigger: A report contains required keys but invalid values, such as schema_version="999" and null coverage, findings, and commands_run.
findings.execution_path: assess_report → _check_schema skips array validation for non-lists and never validates schema_version → finding checks return no reasons for non-list findings → coverage check ignores null → status complete → CLI exits 0.
findings.consequence: Malformed evidence is presented as a complete review with zero findings, contrary to the documented schema-validation boundary.
findings.evidence: The existing valid fixture, mutated with these four invalid values, returned Assessment(status='complete', reasons=(), qualified_ids=(), finding_count=0). A report with every non-SHA field null also returned complete. Existing tests cover absent fields and selected enums, but not these invalid types or versions.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate every schema node's declared type and enum recursively, including array items and nullable fields. Reject booleans as integers. Add negative tests for null/wrong-type containers, invalid schema versions, and malformed finding fields.

findings.title: An unfinished review is indistinguishable from a completed review
findings.trigger: Codex exits successfully with a schema-valid report after inspecting only part of the requested diff, disclosing the unfinished work in summary or limitations.
findings.execution_path: Contract permits only findings/no-findings verdicts and has no completion field → assess_report checks nonempty coverage but no review-completion signal → returns complete → contract step 6 and checkpoint acceptance checklist consume that status without triggering the incomplete-review retry path.
findings.consequence: A partially inspected checkpoint can be represented to the owner as review-complete even when the report explicitly says in-scope files remain unreviewed.
findings.evidence: A valid fixture with coverage=['one file'], summary='Review stopped early', and limitations=['Remaining in-scope files were not inspected'] returned complete with no reasons. The strict repository schema has no review_complete or incomplete_reasons fields, so even fully enforcing its current types would not prevent this case. No test covers successful process termination with unfinished review work.
findings.suggested_fix: Version the contract/schema to require an explicit review_complete boolean and incomplete_reasons list. Require true with no incomplete reasons before returning complete; distinguish unavailable test execution from unfinished diff inspection. Add a regression test for a schema-valid, zero-exit report declaring incomplete scope.
